rejected_actions.resolution: Rejected by the group as unnecessary; would only cause delay

hypotheticals_not_action.detail: Batch variation on supplier B is a watch item to monitor as normal; explicitly no action

expected_decisions: Approve the validation report for release
Accept the residual risk on the temperature excursion

expected_risks: Residual temperature-excursion risk accepted and documented

forbidden_claims: Any populated action in the actions table
'Run another round of testing' promoted to an action (it was rejected)
The batch-variation watch item promoted to an action
Any completed item (report issued, finding two, supplier paperwork) promoted to an action
A placeholder action such as 'Review transcript for agreed actions'
scoring_notes: Pass condition: actions list is EMPTY and rendered with the agreed empty-state wording. This is the counterweight to Rogue #1 (explicit recap). Any manufactured, placeholder, rejected, completed or watch-item action is a hard fail. Decisions and risks should be rich and correctly captured.
